identity_check: Confirmed as Spector.ai (spector.ai), the industrial-AI company headquartered in Santa Clara, California with offices in Houston, Dubai, Brisbane and Bengaluru, run by CEO Prashant Nedungadi. The company site (Agentic Twin platform, asset and process reliability), Inc42 and Entrepreneur India (January 2026, INR 58 crore led by IvyCap Ventures) and Venture Intelligence all describe the same reliability-agent business and name the same founders (Prashant Nedungadi, Sukrit Goel). Matched by domain and description, not by name alone: the press pages describe the same reliability-agent product and the CEO named on spector.ai/about. Category set to 'direct' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; candidate from a discovery search): Spector sells AI agents for asset reliability (predictive maintenance, time-to-fail, root cause), process reliability (upset and quality-excursion prediction) and set-point optimisation, which are Utopian Autonomy's maintenance and process-stability functions, and its engineering base is in Bengaluru. Differences: it targets continuous-process heavy industry first (oil and gas, refining, LNG, chemicals, power, plus cement and steel), sells to reliability and process engineers through an 'Agentic Twin' fed by DCS / historian data with cloud or air-gapped deployment, and does not touch procurement, RFQ, BOM or engineering drawings; no WhatsApp or messaging interface was seen on its site.

company.name: Spector.ai
company.description: Santa Clara-headquartered industrial AI company with a Bengaluru engineering base that sells reliability and performance agents for plant assets and processes.

layer_detail: Reliability and performance agents built on an 'Agentic Twin' per asset or production line: asset reliability (degradation detection, time-to-fail, root cause), process reliability (upset and quality-excursion prediction, e.g. cobbles in a rolling mill), performance optimisation (physics-grounded set points for yield and energy, recommended open-loop to operators) and plant troubleshooting with a GenAI agent using SOPs and event logs. Process industries first (oil and gas, chemicals, power), plus cement, steel and discrete manufacturing. Cloud or on-prem / air-gapped; no WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: Agentic Twin: an AI model of each asset and process built from equipment knowledge, physics and plant data, which watches live signals, forecasts failures and process upsets, explains root causes and recommends energy- and yield-optimal set points, delivered as reliability agents for heavy-industry plants.
pricing: No prices published. The manufacturing page describes a pilot on 2-6 assets over 4-12 weeks with the implementation fee at cost, then a 12-36 month scale-up on an annual SaaS subscription.
